title: The Chamber of Secrets Heist
synopsis: A priceless artifact has vanished from the Chamber of Secrets. As a young Auror, you must interrogate the suspects and uncover the truth before the thief escapes.

setting.location: Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry

victim_paragraph: The Sword of Gryffindor, a legendary artifact said to present itself to any worthy Gryffindor in times of need, has been stolen from its display case in the Chamber of Secrets. The theft occurred sometime between midnight and dawn.
timeline: 11:00 PM - Sword last confirmed in display case by Filch during night patrol
11:30 PM - Suspicious noise reported near the second floor bathroom
12:00 AM - Moaning Myrtle claims to have seen a shadowy figure
2:00 AM - Peeves reports hearing footsteps in the dungeons
5:00 AM - Empty display case discovered by Professor McGonagall

solution.method: Used a vanishing cabinet connected to Borgin and Burkes to transport the sword out of Hogwarts
solution.motive: To restore the Malfoy family's reputation by presenting the sword to the Dark Lord
solution.explanation: Draco repaired the vanishing cabinet in the Room of Requirement and used it to smuggle the sword out. He created a diversion by having Peeves make noise in the dungeons while he made his escape through the cabinet.

case_file.victimDescription: A goblin-made sword imbued with the power to absorb that which makes it stronger
case_file.lastSeen: 11:00 PM in the Chamber display case
case_file.locationFound: Display case in the Chamber of Secrets
initialEvidence: Display case lock shows no signs of forced entry
Faint magical residue detected near the case
Small amount of silver dust found on the floor
